episodes.synopsis: Back in the present, Takemichi is stunned to learn that he has become officer in Toman. Kisaki seizes an opportunity to dupe him, and Takemichi finds himself staring down the barrel of a gun.
episodes.title: It Is What It Is

episodes.synopsis: Back in the past, Takemichi meets Hakkai and Yuzuha Shiba and forms a friendly bond. On the way to the Shiba's home, a chance meeting with Black Dragon turns violent.
episodes.title: Gotta Go

episodes.synopsis: Takemichi is beaten to a pulp by Taiju Shiba. In order to save Takemichi, Hakkai proposes a bargain to Taiju.
episodes.title: Stand Alone

episodes.synopsis: Disaster is avoided when Hakkai offers to join Black Dragon. However, Mitsuya will not allow Hakkai to leave Toman, and confronts Taiju.
episodes.title: Family Bonds

episodes.synopsis: Kisaki and Hanma offer their help to Takemichi and Chifuyu in the rescue of Hakkai and destroying Black Dragon. Takemichi and Chifuyu come to a decision.
episodes.title: Christmas Eve

episodes.synopsis: Propelled by each their own motives, the alliance members head to the church on Christmas night.
episodes.title: Whip Up Morale

episodes.synopsis: Yuzuha's surprise attack on Taiju misses its mark. Takemichi realizes Yuzuha is the key to changing the future, so he gets back into the fight.
episodes.title: Sibling Rivalry

episodes.synopsis: Mitsuya arrives at the church, but is seriously injured in a surprise attack. Finding himself in another pinch, Takemichi gathers himself and makes a bold declaration regarding the future of Black Dragon. Though Taiju continues to beat him down, Takemichi keeps getting back up to face him again.
episodes.title: Strive Together

episodes.synopsis: After revealing his secret, Hakkai overcomes his fear of his brother and faces down Taiju with Takemichi. Just when defeat looks imminent, the familiar sound of a bike engine heralds Mikey's arrival at the church. However, something seems odd about him.
episodes.title: Dawning of a New Era

episodes.synopsis: After defeating Black Dragon, Takemichi finds himself being taken by Mikey to Hina's place, to face the girl he broke up with just the day before.
episodes.title: The Light of My Life

episodes.synopsis: After declaring victory over Black Dragon at Tokyo Manji Gang's first meeting of the year, Mikey makes an unexpected announcement.
episodes.title: On My Way Home

episodes.synopsis: Certain that he has changed the future, Takemichi returns to the present. However, the timeline he returns to is the worst one yet.
episodes.title: Last Order

episodes.synopsis: Takemichi returns to the past to change the horrific new timeline. After meeting Chifuyu, Takemichi realizes what he must do.
episodes.title: When It Rains, It Pours
